verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an ML-driven risk engine that evaluates and scores every transaction (adyen-risk-docs-5, adyen-risk-docs-20) and reaches a block/allow/review decision (adyen-risk-docs-1). Risk information, such as which rules triggered and whether the payment went to case management, can be included in the payment response (adyen-risk-docs-16), which implies in-flow synchronous results. However, the evidence shows no standalone scoring endpoint and does not show an explicit ML score being exposed to developers before authorization completes. missing for 10: a documented standalone or pre-authorization risk-scoring API, explicit return of the ML risk score value in the API response, latency or synchronous-flow documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
